exactGate.hardcodedRequiredChain: FOUNDER_DEPLOY_CHAIN_ID = 56 in founderDeployer.ts (BNB packages only — correct for LB/CT/PFF)

rootCause: Page-level operational banner and paused copy were globally BNB-gated; they ignored package selection from ?chain=avalanche.
